title: Healthy account
description: Stable relationship with no immediate signal.

notes: The customer confirmed they are satisfied with delivery reliability and product quality.
Purchasing renewed the supply agreement for another year.
The account manager reports a constructive relationship and steady order plans.

title: Andes Retail switching risk
description: Strategic account showing signs of supplier switching.

notes: The customer said a competitor offered better commercial conditions.
Purchasing is evaluating alternative suppliers for next quarter.

title: Upsell opportunity
description: Growing account with interest in additional products.

notes: The buyer asked for pricing on two additional product lines.
A new store opening next quarter will require higher volumes.
The customer is satisfied with current service and has no overdue balance.

title: Payment issue
description: Overdue invoices take precedence over other signals.

notes: Two invoices remain unpaid after their due dates.
Accounts payable acknowledged the balance but has not committed to a payment date.
The buyer wants to continue ordering once the balance is resolved.

title: Ambiguous signals
description: Conflicting information calls for human review.

notes: Purchasing asked whether prices can be held for the next quarter and mentioned comparing market offers.
The same buyer said they value our reliable deliveries and intend to renew the relationship.
No supplier change has been approved, but the next purchase forecast remains uncertain.
